description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component of the OpenClawKit project, including mock WebSocket implementations, and tests for connection behaviors, token handling, URL normalization, and event subscription.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking for testing WebSocket interactions, simulating server responses and connection states.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocketSessioning class that creates and manages FakeGatewayWebSocketTask instances for testing connection logic.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor used in tests to detect if a sequence gap event was received after reconnection.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Test that verifies bootstrap token is stored correctly over any existing device token.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Test that ensures additional device tokens are stored during bootstrap handshake.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Test that verifies primary device token is stored but additional tokens are not when bootstrap token is not used.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Test that untrusted bootstrap handshakes do not save bootstrap tokens.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Verifies URL normalization preserves explicitly specified port in secure URLs.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Verifies URL normalization correctly backfills gateway host for loopback URLs.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Tests that invokeWithTimeout returns promptly before timeout when the response is received.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Tests that invokeWithTimeout returns a timeout error if the operation exceeds the timeout duration.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that setting timeout to zero disables the timeout feature.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Validates that a synthetic sequence gap event is emitted after reconnection completes.
